_comment: This file lists the kinds of file an Ikemen GO project can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: The game: an Ikemen GO game folder (the one holding chars/, stages/, data/ and the rest, as an Ikemen GO release unpacks), zipped. The zip may hold the folder itself or its contents. What the core does not find in it - the engine's own data/, external/ and font/ files - it brings itself, from the Ikemen GO it is built with.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: What the game wrote, as Game > Export Save Data gave it: the .zip of the files with their folders (save/config.ini, save/stats.json...), or a single file, which goes into save/. They are put in the game's folder before it starts.
